WITH troponin_items AS (
  SELECT itemid, label
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_labitems`
  WHERE LOWER(label) LIKE '%troponin t%'
),

admissions_with_dx AS (
  SELECT a.*
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  JOIN `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 82 AND 92
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` di
      JOIN `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses` dd
        ON di.icd_code = dd.icd_code
      WHERE di.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
          LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%chest pain%'
          OR LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%myocardial infarction%'
          OR LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%acute myocardial infarction%'
          OR LOWER(dd.long_title) LIKE '%ami%'
        )
    )
),

initial_troponin AS (
  SELECT
    le.subject_id,
    le.hadm_id,
    le.valuenum,
    le.valueuom,
    le.charttime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY le.hadm_id ORDER BY le.charttime) AS rn
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.labevents` le
  JOIN troponin_items ti
    ON le.itemid = ti.itemid
  JOIN admissions_with_dx a
    ON le.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
  WHERE le.charttime >= a.admittime
    AND (a.dischtime IS NULL OR le.charttime <= a.dischtime)
    AND le.valuenum IS NOT NULL
    -- restrict to ng-based units to match ng/mL
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(le.valueuom, '')) LIKE '%ng%'
)

SELECT
  quantiles[OFFSET(1)] AS p25,
  quantiles[OFFSET(2)] AS p50,
  quantiles[OFFSET(3)] AS p75,
  quantiles[OFFSET(0)] AS min_value,
  quantiles[OFFSET(4)] AS max_value
FROM (
  SELECT APPROX_QUANTILES(valuenum, 4) AS quantiles
  FROM initial_troponin
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND valuenum > 0.01
);
